meta.labels: offline_<search>_*: catch_search_map on this list under the unit's overlay; sim_<combination>_*: the 3b unit (ct/catching_trials.csv, trial_results.json). A label belongs to the configuration in `provenance`; the throws are fixed.

candidates.verdicts: phase2 c_{grid,nlp} + phase3 r_{grid,nlp} (C and the refinement union), offline
candidates.docking_rule: nlp refused, and among its wakes other than too_far / settling a docking row is the most frequent

reach.source: catch_search_batch --print-reach-bound (ComputeReachBound, the larger of the searches' ik.eps_pos) + |robot.hand.docking.s_ent| (the nlp target's offset)

grid.source: planner.search.grid.slice.t_lead_min, or planner.freeze.T_freeze when it is open

lead.rule: screen:time when reach_last_s − detection_delay_s < floor_s, the smallest lead floor of the searches in the tree — one threshold for both, so both searches are handed the same throws

differs_from_plan: D-1 'every throw the two searches disagree on' is a farthest-point sample of 20 + 20 (nlp-only, grid-only): the disagreement is thousands of throws (build.json population), not a handful.
T-control is empty: F has no screen:time / screen:reach throw.
T-falseacc is filled from the D-2 candidate pool by the 3b sim results; a short stratum is in `d2_strata`.
T-anchor / T-margin are offline-accepted throws (v0); the sim success criterion is v1's.
